name: extreme-quantization-mastery
description: Use when the user asks about FP8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant, W4A16, W8A8, NF4 or bitsandbytes for LLMs on NVIDIA GPUs. Produces a quantization recipe, code and accuracy-eval plan matched to the GPU and serving engine. Not for format/GGUF basics (use llm-model-quantization) or TensorRT engines (use tensorrt-optimization).
